plugins.name: dev-team
plugins.description: A specialist dev team (PM on opus, researcher on haiku, designer, database engineer, frontend/backend/devops engineers, test engineer, tester, reviewer) orchestrated through a TDD workflow via the /dev-team skill, with a user approval gate on the plan, issue loopback to the PM, an optional live 3D pipeline visualization, and pause/resume support around context compaction.

plugins.name: test-team
plugins.description: A specialist testing team (unit/integration/e2e test engineers, a test-plan runner, and a bug reporter) that writes and runs tests and reports findings as structured bug reports, via the /test-team skill. Findings are written in a format the dev-team plugin's project-manager can consume directly for a fix loop.
